refnamediv.refpurpose: Get the number of events waiting in the queue

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public intRdKafka\Queue::getLength
Returns the number of events waiting in the queue, including queues forwarded to it. Events include messages, delivery reports and callback events; one delivery report event can cover several messages. Messages that are discarded when served, for example after their partition was revoked, are counted until then.
The count does not serve any event and is not a count of messages, outstanding deliveries or consumer lag. It can change as soon as it is returned, so use it as a hint, not to decide that all work is done.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns the number of waiting events.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws an Exception once the queue's client has been destroyed or, for a RdKafka\KafkaConsumer, closed with RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::close.
